name: kicad-happy
description: AI coding agent skills for KiCad electronics design. Works with Claude Code and OpenAI Codex. Analyze schematics, review PCB layouts, EMC pre-compliance, SPICE simulation, download datasheets, source components, and prep boards for fabrication.
summary: KiCad 电子设计 AI 编程助手。支持与 Claude Code 及 OpenAI Codex 集成。可分析原理图、审查 PCB 布局、进行 EMC 预合规性分析、运行 SPICE 仿真、下载数据手册、获取元器件及准备板卡以进行制造
categoryDescription: 开发、调试、评审、测试、架构与工程交付
howToUse: 阅读仓库 README 的安装要求，将 Skill、插件或工具接入对应环境，再按文档触发工作流。
